beats.say: Your PVR ticket versus your popcorn: which one earns the cinema more per hundred rupees? Guess before I tell you.
Start with the ticket. Of every hundred rupees, about forty-three goes to the people who made the film.
lines: PVR INOX film costs vs ticket sales, Jul-Sep 2026

beats.say: So PVR keeps around fifty-seven. Decent. Now the popcorn.
In just three months, we spent six hundred and sixty-eight crore on food at PVR INOX. Up eighteen percent.
And the corn, the butter, the cups? Only about twenty-one rupees of every hundred.
So the popcorn keeps about seventy-eight. Before rent and staff, sure. But the snack beats the ticket. So, what was your guess?
